notesHTML: • Fixed: switching seasons on a show's page now shows that season's episodes. Before, some rows kept the previous season's titles, details and thumbnails.
• The first update delivered by Mezzanine's own updater. Nothing else changes.

• Mezzanine now updates itself: new versions download in the background and install when you quit. Settings ▸ Updates has the switches; Mezzanine ▸ Check for Updates… looks right away. An update never interrupts a film: it waits until the player closes.
  • Installs from a disk image (drag Mezzanine into Applications).
  • Google Cast: Play On picks This Mac or a TV; Cancel while connecting; Resume on This Mac or Try Again if the TV can't play it.
  • Mini player, new-episode notifications, picture size (Fit, Fill, Zoom) and faster starts.
  • Full screen: the empty grey bar that sometimes stayed at the top after the menu bar slid in is gone.
